goal: Track B strongest play: a policy candidate stronger than the research champion (H3 policy + c5 value) at the same S50 budget
question: does a KL(H3 || student) replay term on RenjuNet train positions, added to the c2 policy fine-tune, make the candidate stronger than the champion and better than the unchanged c2 method

renjunet_cache.rule: prepare compares the actual cache with these committed values (never adopts new ones); train and val game_id sets disjoint

inputs.models_metadata: each best.json SHA and content (stage, config) checked with its checkpoint
inputs.consumed: reproduce and train check every input they consume against these expectations (never only the cache manifest) and train on exactly the checked objects

T.cycle: identical to C (rows, batches, order, generator, steps, coefficients)

replay.generator_seed: training seed + 1000003; draws the indices and the D4 symmetries; the cycle generator is untouched
replay.input: the same D4-transformed planes and legal mask for H3 and the student
replay.distribution: logits masked to -inf off the legal moves, then log_softmax (renormalised over legal moves)
replay.loss: per position sum over legal a of p_H3(a) (log p_H3(a) - log p_student(a)); mean over the 512 positions
replay.total: L = L_cycle (unchanged definition and batch mean) + mu * KL_replay
replay.added_to: the unchanged cycle loss (no cycle row is replaced)

training.selection: the c2 rule for both arms: guard (RenjuNet val top-1) within guard_drop of H3, lowest cycle val objective; the replay term is not in the selection metric

records.replay_kl: step mean during training and, at every evaluation, on the whole RenjuNet val split; both arms; no_grad and eval, outside the training path and its generators; never a selection metric

seeds.arena_seed_rule: H7-R reserved block 8781-8799 (h7r_eval.SEED_BLOCK); unused by committed contracts: 8788-8794; 8795-8796 test fixtures; 8791-8794 left for the confirmation stage

stages.prepare: compare with the committed values: cycle rows file SHA and row counts, H3 and c5 checkpoints and best.json, the H3 cache manifest identity and train / val tensor hashes, states and games; train / val game ids disjoint; the c2 record SHAs

reproduce.run: new trainer, replay off, seed 20261024, the c2 inputs and settings
exact: input SHAs, settings, parent and teacher identity
eligibility [true, true, false, false, true, true, false, true, false, false]
within_1e-6: val objective, ce, kl and guard top-1 at every evaluation
reproduce.miss: stop before any Arena; the tolerance is never widened afterwards
reproduce.premise: h7c_train.py changed after c7e4123 only on the value side (f0b0022, 0ced742, 76e8a49)

stages.train: 3 seeds x 2 arms; the committed reproduction is re-judged from its content (seed, c2 record SHA, the rules applied again) before any run; the arena candidate seed failing stops
stages.link: T and C of seed 20261024 both CANDIDATE, else stop (no other seed substituted)
stages.arena: section arena; one run, no resizing, no rerun
stages.judge: the Arena contract must equal the one rebuilt from this contract and the verified link (models, link SHA, every arm, suites, pairs, seeds, pairings, budgets, statistics); every arm record complete; then section reading

arena.pairing: within a suite T and C share openings, game seeds and pairing
arena.sample_note: O0 has 75 symmetry classes: 600 pairs are not 600 independent samples
arena.overlap_note: some sequences overlap the R1 pilot and earlier arenas; allowed for a development reading

planning.note: a planning value, not a guarantee; the SD of T - C depends on the arms' covariance

cost.measured: each arm record keeps its wall time (h7r_eval play); the measured cost is reported and never changes the size (h7r_eval play has no partial-arm smoke)

auxiliary.use: descriptive only: never a reading, a stability verdict or a promotion ground

statistics.stratified: resample openings within each suite (300 and 300 fixed); the T and C results of a drawn opening move together
statistics.combined: 0.5 x O0 mean + 0.5 x O1 mean (fixed weights)
statistics.sensitivity: class-level stratified bootstrap (classes resampled within a suite, all their openings together, the same 50:50 weights); reported, not read

D.what: T - C pair-score differences on the same openings (stratified, 50:50)
D.rule: the arms differ only by D, never by one arm being significant against the champion and the other not

interpretation.P STRONGER: a development candidate for the separate confirmation stage; no champion change
interpretation.P not STRONGER, D BETTER_THAN_CONTROL: the policy-preserving term helped over the old method, consistent with the knowledge-loss hypothesis; not stronger than the champion (regression mitigated only)
interpretation.P not STRONGER, D NOT_ESTABLISHED: the effect of this treatment is not established; the hypothesis is not ruled out (weight, sample or precision may miss it)
interpretation.P not STRONGER, D WORSE_THAN_CONTROL: this treatment did worse than the old method; not a ruling on the hypothesis

reading.not_used: the value epsilon, the R2 H-dev reading and the D4 reading are neither changed nor applied
reading.end: P not STRONGER ends the contract; another weight or the human-move CE is a new contract

separate_stages: independent confirmation (confirmation suites, seeds 8791-8794, H-conf selection quality)
anchor non-inferiority (original H3 / H6), tactical v2, per-move time gate

implementation_scope.judge: scripts/h7r_p1.py judge: reads the verified h7r_eval arm records; the stratified 50:50 paired bootstrap and the class sensitivity
implementation_scope.arena_contract: scripts/h7r_p1.py arena-contract: the h7r_eval-format contract (eight arms, seeds 8788-8790) from the link record and the experiment_sha256, after training and before any result

data_rule: RenjuNet-derived data, caches and models stay under data/ or runs/; only hashes and numbers are committed

identity.experiment_sha256: sha256 of the canonical JSON of this contract without "approved"; links prepare, train, link and Arena records
identity.contract_file_sha256: recorded separately by every run (changes with approval commits)

records.note: runs/ is git-ignored: the committed copies of run records live in seed-records

invariance: every command records HEAD (clean), the contract file, the sources and the files it reads at its start and checks them again right before it publishes; a change publishes nothing
